objective: A family of multi-tenant ruvector services (rv-vector, rv-quant, rv-graph, rv-mincut, rv-registry, rv-mcp) on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects behind the ruvector-edge-auth edge authorization server, which federates login to auth.cognitum.one and mints its own ES256 access tokens with aud = the exact canonical resource URL. Cloudflare account 501c77f558c68152352b8ddfade9b854, workers.dev subdomain cognitum-consulting-mail, no custom domains. Rust/wasm32 (workers-rs) throughout; no Cloudflare resource or OAuth-provider change without a separate, explicit gate approval.
adr_status: Proposed (revised 2026-09-28; reconciled 2026-09-29 with the edge-AS decision) — moves to Accepted only at M6

scaffolded_crates: crates/ruvector-edge-auth (jws, jwks, claims, audience, resource, subject (edge_subject), scopes, prm, verifier, clock, error — RS verification core; M0 adds trust_root)

crates/ruvector-edge-authz (client (DCR), authorize, pkce, code (replay tombstones), federation, token (RFC 9068 mint with upstream_iss + edge sub), grant (TokenEndpoint), params, refresh, revoke, metadata, resource, ports, error — edge AS core)

crates/ruvector-edge-tenancy (context (from_verified(claims, role, surface), scope ∩ role), names (do_name by collection_uid), uid (v2, nonce), shard, meta, membership, lease, validate, quota, problem, error)
baseline_state.edge_dir: edge/ standalone workspace (worker =0.8.5, wasm-bindgen =0.2.125): edge/auth-worker (Worker ruvector-edge-auth: lib, config, platform, signer (EDGE_AUTH_SIGNING_JWK), store (AuthStore DO), sql + sql_ports (schema v1), upstream, http, endpoints/{authorize,consent,callback,register,token}; optional MAX_CLIENTS) and edge/gateway (Worker ruvector-edge-gateway: lib, config, routes, auth, keys, platform, respond; EDGE_AUTH Service Binding for the edge JWKS)
baseline_state.note: ADR §8 deltas, status 2026-09-29 (working tree, uncommitted alignment pass). CLOSED: (1) scope vocabulary ruvector:read/write/admin/publish + offline_access (SCOPE_TABLE v3 incl. ruvector:publish; Admin and PublishPublic never on the MCP surface; Owner role ceiling includes Admin; per-document PRM scopes; 401 challenge scope "ruvector:read offline_access"); (4) per-resource grant rule requested ∩ client ceiling ∩ resource scopes (ResourceAllowlist entries carry scopes; admin only for /v1; out-of-ceiling vocabulary dropped, unknown invalid_scope), DCR default ceiling compiled DEFAULT_CLIENT_SCOPE = ruvector:read ruvector:write offline_access, /authorize default grant ruvector:read + offline_access (both 'granted by default' per the §5.3 table), omitted grant_types -> both, refresh follows registered grant_types not offline_access, client_name ASCII-only; (6) gateway trust root compiled (edge/gateway/src/trust_root.rs; vars only under dev-issuer; contradicting var -> 503 trust_root_mismatch; only UPSTREAM_FIRST_PARTY stays a var), edge lifetime cap 900 s, ACCEPTED_UPSTREAM_KIDS on both Workers (empty until G1); gateway fetches the edge JWKS only via the EDGE_AUTH Service Binding (no public fallback, 1042). Also: AccessTokenClaims carry act (exchanged only); TenantContext keys tenant_key on the token upstream_iss claim (§16.2); RESOURCE_ALLOWLIST adds https://team.ruv.io/mcp with ruvector:read ruvector:write offline_access (no team:* vocabulary, so a §16.1 exchange can keep scope ⊆ subject; gateway never accepts that aud); ResourceEntry refuses any scope outside the §5.3 vocabulary, so scopes_supported (derived from the allowlist) is exactly §5.3; consent page discloses 'stays signed in for up to 90 days' whenever the client registered the refresh grant; prm::step_up_scope(capability) builds the 403 challenge scope (wiring waits on the role source, open (1)); /authorize answers temporarily_unavailable with a static pending description while UPSTREAM_CLIENT_ID/ACCEPTED_UPSTREAM_KIDS are empty (G1, console#605). Earlier: (2) identity-only UPSTREAM_SCOPES, (5) PRM per resource + bare path 404 + Expose-Headers, (7) consent verified marker + upstream refresh revoke, (9) env -u RUSTFLAGS build; (10) every aud mismatch (other gateway resource, adapter resource, array) is 401 invalid_token with error_description="audience mismatch" + this route's resource_metadata (sibling 403 carve-out removed; audience_not_allowed is only the log reason). STILL OPEN: (1) RouteSurface::Ops and role column in ROUTE_TABLE; (3) AuthStore subjects table (dcr_rate and redeemed_codes exist); (4) localhost loopback redirects; (6) auth-worker ISSUER/UPSTREAM_* still [vars] (not compiled); (8) version pins 0.8.5/0.2.125 recorded; (11) REFRESH_REUSE_GRACE_SECS; M1: token-exchange grant, private_key_jwt adapter clients.

milestones.name: Cores including authz (no deploy, no Cloudflare or provider changes)
milestones.criteria: ruvector-edge-auth, ruvector-edge-authz and ruvector-edge-tenancy implemented per ADR §4-§5 and every §8 working-tree delta closed (M1-marked items excepted); native tests pass (minted-token golden test with the exact §5.2 claim set, refresh grace and reuse detection, code-replay revocation, flow-cookie binding, §5.3 scope grant rule, 401 on aud mismatch, upstream-mode ID-token and typ=inference cases, trust-root mismatch on both Workers); route-table gap test passes; both Workers build for wasm32 with env -u RUSTFLAGS; every file under 500 lines; JWS/JWKS/DCR/token-form/ResourceUrl fuzzers run 10 min with no panic.

milestones.name: Deploy ruvector-edge-auth + gateway to workers.dev: upstream DCR, signing key as wrangler secret, live discovery + login round trip
milestones.criteria: Live: AS metadata, JWKS and both PRM documents (/v1, /v1/mcp) name the edge issuer, bare-origin PRM 404; POST /v1/mcp without a token returns the 401 challenge with the /v1/mcp resource_metadata; a browser user completes DCR -> consent -> upstream login -> callback -> token and GET /v1/me returns the edge sub and tenant_key; the token carries exactly the §5.2 claims; it is refused by the gateway's other resource (401 invalid_token + resource_metadata) and at api.cognitum.one/v1/mcp; replayed code, replayed state and mismatched flow cookie refused; refresh rotates, a concurrent refresh inside the 30 s grace does not revoke, reuse after it revokes the family, /revoke works; Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Claude Code (http://localhost) and MCP Inspector complete discovery -> DCR -> consent -> token for the /v1/mcp audience with a refresh token; no upstream token in storage or logs; M0.5 [U]s resolved (upstream iss parameter, connector scope/grant_types requests and step-up behaviour, DCR limits).

milestones.name: rv-vector MVP, exact flat scan, connectors end to end
milestones.criteria: Locally and live: login -> claim -> create -> upsert 1k x 384 -> exact top-10 equals native brute force; tenant B gets 404 on tenant A's names; non-member gets 403; no upsert without ruvector:write, even as owner; foreign-iss, wrong-aud, upstream (mode off) and ID tokens rejected; 413 at the shard cap, 429 at the rate limit; four 12 MB shards stay resident and a fifth evicts, not crashes; instantiate < 600 ms and lazy-load p95 < 1 s; Claude.ai and ChatGPT connectors run vector_query, step up to ruvector:write on consent (HTTP 403 insufficient_scope challenge) and run a dry_run vector_upsert; /v1/ops accepts only aud = …/v1 tokens obtained by the RFC 8693 exchange grant (confidential private_key_jwt adapter clients, act claim audited; an adapter-audience token gets 401), refuses a mismatched target or tenant_key and never applies an op_id twice.

milestones.name: int8 flat scan with f32 rerank (today's crates)
milestones.criteria: recall@10 >= 0.95 against FlatIndex on 20k x 384 random vectors and one real-embedding set; >= 3 shards per isolate at the measured per-shard cap; a quantizer change re-encodes without blocking queries for more than one slice.

milestones.name: HNSW (gated on G4a)
milestones.criteria: recall@10 >= 0.95 against FlatIndex; warm query p50 < 10 ms [U]; >= 2 full HNSW shards fit the isolate cap; lazy-load p95 < 1 s with <= 200-op replay; a corrupted chunk falls back with identical results; a gapped-iid encode fails loudly.

milestones.name: Durability, ingest, embeddings, control plane, result pages (gated on G3)
milestones.criteria: A kill-and-restore drill returns byte-identical results; cross-tenant restore, a tampered snapshot and a foreign upload_id are refused; a 100k-vector import stays within quota and the isolate cap; a global deny takes effect within 60 s; usage reconciles within 1%; a signed result page's witness verifies offline and a redacted key is absent; fuzzers run 1 h clean.

milestones.name: rv-quant, rv-graph, rv-mincut (gated on G4b/G4c)
milestones.criteria: A 50k x 384 rabitq cold load fits the CPU and memory budgets; a viewer cannot run a mutating Cypher query; mincut on 50k edges equals the native crate; an exhausted budget returns 413, not 500.

milestones.name: rv-registry and the full rv-mcp tool set
milestones.criteria: Every mutating MCP tool needs ruvector:write + editor and honours dry_run; a /v1/mcp connector token gets 401 (audience mismatch) on /v1 REST; an RVF from the rvf CLI imports via upload_id and queries correctly; the Launch Doctor conformance checker (ADR §9.1) passes against the live hosts.

milestones.name: Hardening and GA (gated on G5 and G6)
milestones.criteria: No open high or critical pentest findings (incl. consent phishing, code injection, refresh theft, token-exchange abuse, upstream deprovisioning, key rotation, upstream-token replay); p50 query < 30 ms and p99 < 150 ms at the edge for single-shard 384-dim collections [U]; this ADR moves to Accepted.

risks: ADR numbering collision: ADR-350/ADR-351 range has multiple open claimants; renumber if taken before merge.

G1 is on the M0.5 critical path and is a provider touch: at console ce9ddca the upstream DCR redirect allowlist refuses the edge callback, so one exact ALLOWED_EXACT_REDIRECTS line (or a hand-seeded client) must pass console review; ADR-124 does not pre-approve it.

Working-tree code still deviates from the ADR (§8) in: auth-worker ISSUER/UPSTREAM_* trust roots still [vars] (gateway trust root is compiled), no RouteSurface::Ops / role column in ROUTE_TABLE, localhost loopback redirects refused, aud mismatch mapped to 403 instead of 401, no REFRESH_REUSE_GRACE_SECS, no AuthStore subjects table. Closed 2026-09-29: mcp:* vocabulary and mcp:read upstream scope, DCR full-set default, gateway [vars] trust root.

Open DCR at the edge AS accepts any https and loopback redirect: consent-page quality, the unverified-host marker, write only on explicit consented request, clickjacking headers and DCR rate limits are the phishing defence; upstream deprovisioning is not propagated (≤ 90 d without an operator action).
Single global AuthStore DO (~500-1,000 req/s) and a single ES256 signing key held as a wrangler secret: availability and key-compromise procedures must be exercised before GA.

Several load-bearing facts are [U]: Rate Limiting locality, DO CPU-limit source, D1 size limits, upstream ID-token contents and RFC 9207 support, connector scope requests, HNSW warm p50 and the M6 latency targets.
G4 upstream crate PRs gate M2b and M4; team tenancy (G5) still needs an upstream org selector or org-role claim.
workers.dev hosts are the issuer and audiences until G6; moving hosts changes every aud and forces a re-login for all clients and adapters.

drift_detection.scope_drift: Flag if work expands beyond the edge AS, rv-gateway and the services in ADR §3 (rv-vector, TenantLedger, rv-snapshot, rv-embed, rv-ingest, rv-quant, rv-graph, rv-mincut, rv-registry, rv-mcp, /v1/results signed result pages) plus the §16 adapter contract (/v1/ops, RFC 8693 exchange for adapter clients), or touches Cloudflare resources/OAuth provider settings without a listed gate (G1-G6) being explicitly approved.
drift_detection.timeline_drift: Flag if milestone velocity suggests M6 (Accepted) will not land, or if a milestone is marked done without its acceptance criteria being verifiably met (milestones are binary, no partial credit).
drift_detection.approach_drift: Flag if the Rust-only house rule is violated; if any resource server accepts anything but exact-aud edge tokens outside the flagged upstream mode (no second audience on /v1/ops — adapters must use the RFC 8693 exchange with act, the only non-user token path); if the edge AS requests non-identity upstream scopes or persists upstream tokens; if an aud mismatch returns anything but 401 with resource_metadata; or if per-shard/isolate caps are set without measurement.
drift_detection.dependency_drift: Flag if G1 review stalls (blocks M0.5) or if the G4 upstream PRs stall or change shape (block M2b, M4).
drift_detection.priority_drift: Flag if the effort loses cadence versus the /loop 5m cycle it was started under.
